diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2.15 V, datasheet reading 3.3 V
diffs.evidence: Sensirion SHT3x-DIS datasheet Table 3: 'Supply voltage VDD 2.15 (min) 3.3 (typ) 5.5 (max) V'; front page: 'Wide supply voltage range, from 2.15 V to 5.5 V'. 3.3 V is the typical value, not the minimum. Seeed wiki for the Grove SHT35 (101020592) Power section: 'the input voltage of this chip range from 2.15v-5.5v, so you can use both 3.3v and 5v pin of Arduino to supply for this module' (no regulator; VCC goes to the chip). The wiki's 'Operating Voltage 3.3V / 5V' lists the two common host rails, not limits.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Sensirion SHT3x-DIS datasheet Table 3: 'Supply voltage VDD 2.15 / 3.3 / 5.5 V' (max 5.5 V; absolute max -0.3 to 6 V). Seeed Grove SHT35 wiki: 'the input voltage of this chip range from 2.15v-5.5v'. The second reading took 5 V from the wiki's 'Operating Voltage 3.3V / 5V' line, which names supported host rails rather than the maximum.
